questions.question: Choose the correct reading for the kanji |四時|.
questions.explanation: According to the Week 2 syllabus, 4:00 is a specific exception and must be pronounced as よじ (yoji).

questions.question: Which particle is used to indicate a |means of transport|, such as in 'でんしゃ... いきます'?
questions.explanation: The particle で is used to denote the means or method of transportation.

questions.question: Identify the correct negative past form of |べんきょうします|.
choices: べんきょうしませでした
べんきょうしませんでした
questions.answer: べんきょうしませんでした
questions.explanation: The negative past form of ます verbs is ませんでした.

questions.question: What is the correct reading for |七時|?
questions.explanation: The syllabus notes that 7:00 is pronounced as しちじ (shichiji).

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'わたしは |あるいて| がっこうへ いきます。' Which particle follows |あるいて|?
questions.explanation: As noted in the lesson, the term 歩いて (walking) is an exception and does not use the particle で.

questions.question: Which kanji represents |Wednesday|?
questions.explanation: 水曜日 (Suiyoubi) means Wednesday.

questions.question: What is the reading of the kanji |九時|?
questions.explanation: 9:00 is a designated exception in time-telling and is read as くじ (kuji).

questions.question: Which particle indicates the |direction| or |destination| of movement?
questions.explanation: The particle へ is used to indicate the direction or destination when using movement verbs like 行きます.

questions.question: Translate: 'I wake up |at 7:00|.'
questions.explanation: The particle に is used to mark a specific point in time.

questions.question: Choose the correct kanji for |Monday|.
questions.explanation: 月曜日 (Getsuyoubi) represents Monday.

questions.question: How do you say |10:30| in Japanese?
questions.explanation: Both ~じさんじゅっぷん and ~じはん (half past) are correct ways to express the half-hour.

questions.question: Which verb means |to work|?
questions.explanation: はたらきます (hatarakimasu) translates to 'to work'.

questions.question: What does |どこ| ask for?
questions.explanation: どこ (doko) is the interrogative for location.

questions.question: Identify the kanji for |800 yen|.
questions.explanation: 円 (en) is the kanji for the Japanese currency, Yen.

questions.question: Which particle means |'together with'| a person?
questions.explanation: The particle と is used to indicate the person with whom an action is performed.

questions.question: What is the meaning of the verb |帰ります|?
questions.explanation: 帰ります (kaerimasu) specifically means to return back to one's home or base.

questions.question: How is |6 minutes| pronounced?
questions.explanation: As per the rules for minutes, 6 minutes is pronounced as ろっぷん (roppun).

questions.question: Identify the kanji for |Saturday|.
questions.explanation: 土曜日 (Doyoubi) represents Saturday.

questions.question: Which phrase is used to ask |'How much is this?'|
questions.explanation: いくら (ikura) is used to inquire about the price of an object.

questions.question: Which particle marks the |direct object| of an action?
questions.explanation: The particle を follows the noun that is the direct object of the verb.

questions.question: What is the reading of |三階|?
questions.explanation: The counter for the 3rd floor (3階) changes to 'gai' for phonetic reasons: さんがい.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |あそこ|.
questions.explanation: あそこ (asoko) refers to a location far from both the speaker and listener.

questions.question: Which kanji means |'person'|?
questions.explanation: 人 (hito/jin) is the kanji for person.

questions.question: What is the correct translation for |'Every day'|?
questions.explanation: まいにち (mainichi) means every day.

questions.question: Which verb means |'to finish'| or |'to end'|?
questions.explanation: おわります (owarimasu) means to end or finish.

questions.question: Translate: 'From 9:00 |to| 5:00.'
questions.explanation: から (from) and まで (until) are used to indicate time spans.

questions.question: Which kanji represents |Tuesday|?
questions.explanation: 火曜日 (Kayoubi) is Tuesday.

questions.question: What is the meaning of |じむしょ|?
questions.explanation: じむしょ (jimusho) refers to an office.

questions.question: How do you read |五分|?
questions.explanation: According to the minute reading rules, 5 minutes is pronounced ごふん (gofun).

questions.question: What is the kanji for |mountain|?
questions.explanation: 山 (yama) is the kanji for mountain.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |うけつけ|.
questions.explanation: うけつけ (uketsuke) means the reception or information counter.

questions.question: Which particle is used for |'Today'| in the sentence: 'Today I work'?
questions.explanation: Relative time words like 今日 (kyou) do not take the particle に.

questions.question: What is the reading of the kanji |六|?
questions.explanation: 六 is the kanji for the number 6.

questions.question: Which verb means |'to eat'|?
questions.explanation: たべます (tabemasu) is the verb for eating.

questions.question: Translate: |'What day is it today?'|
choices: きょうはなんじですか
きょうはなんようびですか
きょうはいくらですか
questions.answer: きょうはなんようびですか
questions.explanation: 何曜日 (nanyoubi) is the interrogative used for days of the week.

questions.question: Identify the past affirmative form of |ねます|.
questions.explanation: The past affirmative form of ます verbs is ました.

questions.question: Which kanji represents |Thursday|?
questions.explanation: 木曜日 (Mokuyoubi) is Thursday.

questions.question: What is the meaning of |でんしゃ|?
questions.explanation: でんしゃ (densha) means electric train.

questions.question: How do you read |八時|?
questions.explanation: 八時 (hachiji) means 8:00.

questions.question: Which verb means |'to read'|?
questions.explanation: よみます (yomimasu) means to read.

questions.question: Which particle relates the |source and destination| in: 'うち... がっこうまで'?
questions.explanation: から marks the starting point (from).

questions.question: What is the reading of the kanji |十|?
questions.explanation: 十 is the kanji for the number 10.

questions.question: Which kanji represents |Friday|?
questions.explanation: 金曜日 (Kinyoubi) means Friday.

questions.question: What does |いつ| mean?
questions.explanation: いつ (itsu) is the interrogative for time.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |かばん|.
questions.explanation: かばん (kaban) means bag.

questions.question: Which verb means |'to sleep'| or |'to go to bed'|?
questions.explanation: ねます (nemasu) means to sleep.

questions.question: How do you read |三分|?
questions.explanation: The reading rule for 3 minutes is さんぷん (sanpun).

questions.question: Which kanji represents |Sunday|?
questions.explanation: 日曜日 (Nichiyoubi) is Sunday.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |ひこうき|.
questions.explanation: ひこうき (hikouki) means airplane.

questions.question: Which particle is used for |'by'| a specific method in: '日本語... はなします'?
questions.explanation: で is used to indicate the means or tool used for an action.

questions.question: What is the reading of |二|?
questions.explanation: 二 is the kanji for the number 2.

questions.question: Which verb means |'to listen'|?
questions.explanation: ききます (kikimasu) means to listen.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |えき|.
questions.explanation: えき (eki) means train station.

questions.question: Translate: |'What time is it now?'|
choices: いまなんようびですか
questions.explanation: 何時 (nanji) is the interrogative used for time.

questions.question: Which particle is used to mean |'and'| between nouns?
questions.explanation: と is used to connect nouns together.

questions.question: What is the reading of |五|?
questions.explanation: 五 is the kanji for the number 5.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |じてんしゃ|.
questions.explanation: じてんしゃ (jitensha) means bicycle.

questions.question: Which verb means |'to watch'| or |'to see'|?
questions.explanation: みます (mimasu) means to see, watch, or look.

questions.question: Translate: 'I study |at the library|.' Which particle marks the location of the action?
questions.explanation: The particle で is used to mark the location where an action takes place.

questions.question: What is the reading of |三|?
questions.explanation: 三 is the kanji for the number 3.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |くるま|.
questions.explanation: くるま (kuruma) means car.

questions.question: Which verb means |'to drink'|?
questions.explanation: のみます (nomimasu) means to drink.

questions.question: Translate: |'I go to Japan.'|
questions.explanation: へ marks the destination for movement verbs like いきます.

questions.question: What is the reading of |八|?
questions.explanation: 八 is the kanji for the number 8.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |くつ|.
questions.explanation: くつ (kutsu) means shoes.

questions.question: Which particle connects a |person| to a destination in: 'ともだち... うちへ いきます'?
questions.explanation: と indicates the companion with whom the action is performed.

questions.question: What is the reading of |一|?
questions.explanation: 一 is the kanji for the number 1.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |しんかんせん|.
questions.explanation: しんかんせん (shinkansen) is the Japanese high-speed bullet train.

questions.question: Which verb means |'to start'| or |'to begin'|?
questions.explanation: はじまります (hajimarimasu) means to begin.

questions.question: Translate: |'What is your birthday?'|
choices: たんじょうびはいつですか
たんじょうびはどこですか
たんじょうびはなんじですか
たんじょうびはいくらですか
questions.answer: たんじょうびはいつですか
questions.explanation: いつ (itsu) is used to ask when something occurs, such as a birthday.

questions.question: What is the reading of |七|?
questions.explanation: 七 is the kanji for the number 7.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |ねくたい|.
questions.explanation: ねくたい (nekutai) means necktie.

questions.question: Which particle marks the |topic| of the sentence?
questions.explanation: は is the topic marker particle.

questions.question: What is the reading of |四|?
questions.explanation: 四 is the kanji for the number 4.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |ばんごう|.
questions.explanation: ばんごう (bangou) means number (like a phone number).

questions.question: Which verb means |'to wake up'|?
questions.explanation: おきます (okimasu) means to wake up.

questions.question: What is the reading of |九|?
questions.explanation: 九 is the kanji for the number 9.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |かいだん|.
questions.explanation: かいだん (kaidan) means stairs or staircase.

questions.question: Which particle is used to mark |point of origin| in: 'ベトナム... きました'?
questions.explanation: から indicates origin or starting point.

questions.question: What is the reading of |十|?
questions.explanation: 十 is the kanji for the number 10.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |でんわ|.
questions.explanation: でんわ (denwa) means telephone.

questions.question: Which verb means |'to come'|?
questions.explanation: きます (kimasu) means to come.

questions.question: What is the reading of |日月| in |日曜日| and |月曜日|?
questions.explanation: 日 is read as にち in 日曜日, and 月 is read as げつ in 月曜日.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |かさ|.
questions.explanation: かさ (kasa) means umbrella.

questions.question: Which particle indicates the |end point| of time or space?
questions.explanation: まで indicates the ending point (until).

questions.question: What is the reading of |火水| in |火曜日| and |水曜日|?
questions.explanation: 火 is read as か, and 水 is read as すい in the context of days of the week.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |かいしゃ|.
questions.explanation: かいしゃ (kaisha) means company or office.

questions.question: Which verb means |'to study'|?
questions.explanation: べんきょうします (benkyoushimasu) means to study.

questions.question: What is the reading of |木金| in |木曜日| and |金曜日|?
questions.explanation: 木 is read as もく, and 金 is read as きん.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |ぎんこう|.
questions.explanation: ぎんこう (ginkou) means bank.

questions.question: Which particle is used to mark the |destination| for |帰ります|?
questions.explanation: Either に or へ can be used to indicate the destination of movement.

questions.question: What is the reading of |土| in |土曜日|?
questions.explanation: 土 is read as ど in the context of Saturday.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |としょかん|.
questions.explanation: としょかん (toshokan) means library.

questions.question: Which verb means |'to take a holiday'| or |'to rest'|?
questions.explanation: やすみます (yasumimasu) means to rest or take a holiday.

questions.question: What is the reading of |人| in |日本人|?
questions.explanation: When used for nationality, 人 is read as じん.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |ゆうびんきょく|.
questions.explanation: ゆうびんきょく (yuubinkyoku) means post office.

questions.question: Which particle is used to indicate |time| when it's not a specific number (e.g. 'tomorrow')?
questions.explanation: Non-specific time words like あした (tomorrow) do not require particle に.

questions.question: What is the reading of |円|?
questions.explanation: 円 is read as えん (en) for currency.

questions.question: Identify the meaning of |デパート|.
questions.explanation: デパート (depa-to) means department store.

questions.question: Which verb means |'to go'|?
questions.explanation: いきます (ikimasu) means to go.
